title: Arming act
description: Sets ODIN's rung for a named batch of runs (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §5.4, §16.2). Signed with the Director's TYR-0 key under the namespace aesir-arm; the signature is a separate file. Without a valid act covering the run, ODIN's rung is HUMAN_ONLY.

rung.description: ODIN is armed at AI_AUTONOMOUS in every phase (§1, §5.4).

runs.description: The run IDs this act covers.

plan_chain_hashes.description: The SHA-256 of each plan file's exact signed bytes (§16.2 U18), for every plan any run the act covers may fly. BALDUR-0 requires every plan in a run's chain to appear here.
